Company Announcement

Whole Foods Market is recalling Cabricharme cheese because egg is not declared on the product label. People with an egg allergy risk a serious reaction.

The cheese was sold at 18 stores in Arizona, California, Connecticut, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, and Rhode Island.

Recalled product was cut and wrapped with Whole Foods Market scale labels:

Product DescriptionPLUStatesBest By Dates
Cabricharme Raw Milk Cheese57953California, New JerseyThrough 10/7/2026

No illnesses have been reported. Consumers should destroy the affected product.
